resources.string: A slim pill at the top right of the TV shows the volume level for a moment whenever the volume changes, over every app. For TVs whose sound runs through an amplifier over HDMI ARC and that draw no volume bar of their own. The pill appears when the level lands, so a moment after the key press, with the true level.
Allowed to draw over other apps: the pill can be seen.

Not allowed to draw over other apps yet, so nothing can be shown. On the TV: Settings ▸ Apps ▸ Volume pill ▸ Display over other apps. Over ADB:\nadb shell appops set io.github.hccullen.volumehud SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Shows the volume when it changes
